fields.description: If assignment is off, new tickets stay unassigned and the department lead distributes them manually.
fields.label: Assign tickets automatically

fields.description: Key of a registered strategy, e.g. by_workload. See ticket_billing/assignment/strategies/ for available ones.
fields.label: Assignment strategy

fields.description: Department for tickets that could not be routed — for example from a mailbox without a department.

fields.description: Applied to new time entries unless something else is given.

fields.description: A running timer is highlighted once it exceeds this many hours. Usually it means someone forgot to stop it.
fields.label: Warn after (hours)

fields.description: The department lead gets a daily notification about draft time entries older than this.
fields.label: Remind about drafts after (days)
